source: CRON 20261122: H1 2026 column from the issuer unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026, summarised statement of comprehensive income, unit R thousands multiplied by 1,000 to match the absolute rand columns. Cost of Sales and Gross Profit stay empty because the issuer prints no cost of sales line. Operating Expenses is the printed expenditure of 6343. Gross income less expenditure equals the printed net income before taxation of 347601, no taxation was recognised in the period, and total comprehensive income attributable to equity shareholders is 347601. EPS is the printed 924.5 cents converted to rand.
